eldencraft.pairing.short: Different character. Press T for help.
eldencraft.pairing.details: [EldenCraft] This Minecraft world belongs to another Elden Ring character. Load that character to keep playing here. For a new character, save and close both games and PCL, then run SELECT-EldenCraft-WORLD.cmd and choose a new world profile. Existing items and progress stay in the old world. Use the same profile and character together on later launches.
